MCP OAuth expires_at/created_at/updated_at use DATETIME(6); MySQL connections enforce UTC for the timestamptz-equivalent contract. No existing timestamps on a fresh install.
agent_prompts and agent_run_suspensions tables, prompt lease/expiry/session/message indexes, and messages.run_state are included in the baseline.
tenants.assistant_config is a nullable JSON column.
sessions.kind defaults to empty and tenant/kind/user/updated_at/deleted_at index supports live assistant listings. Assistant-kind legacy backfill has no rows on a fresh install.
Data-only legacy Feishu/Lark resync_required backfill; fresh database has no data_sources rows and requires no schema or seed change.
Nonunique resources(tenant_id, content_hash, deleted_at) index supports live content-hash lookups; MySQL includes deleted/empty rows in this nonunique index.
agent_collaborations table plus status/owner indexes; generated nullable active_parent implements PostgreSQL uniqueness across active and cancelling parent runs.
Data-only cleanup of pre-existing single-image chunks with the empty SHA-256; fresh database has no chunks to clean. Existing chunk_images projection triggers remain installed.
mcp_tool_approvals.risk and observed_risk are nonnull VARCHAR(16) with empty defaults.
agent_grants table, full case-sensitive tenant/user/scope/scope_id/grant_key uniqueness and scope lookup index.
automations, automation_runs, notifications final tables and due/owner/deleted/user/status indexes; automation slot uniqueness includes microsecond scheduled_at and trigger_kind.
sessions.owner_auth_source is nonnull VARCHAR(32) with empty default for unknown owners.
session_sandbox_assignments and sandbox_user_machines tables with placement/config/owner/retention lookup indexes. Nonunique MySQL indexes include rows excluded by PostgreSQL partial predicates.
automation_runs.execution_duration_ms is nonnull BIGINT default 0.
automations.model_id is nonnull VARCHAR(64) default empty.
Final automations schema omits agent_id; the assistant and optional model_id drive automation execution.
